scope: Single secondary output-budget sensitivity, fixed after base cap8 limitation and before adapter retention scores were inspected. Primary8token results unchanged.

scores.scoring: NFKC + strip. Strict: entire output is A-D, case-insensitive. Fallback: strict choice if valid, otherwise first case-preserved word-boundary uppercase A-D; lowercase prose is never uppercased. Ambiguity and invalid outputs reported separately.

timing.scope: Synchronized batched generate wall time; includes prefill/decode; excludes tokenization, device transfers and decoding. Pipeline time includes these. Count through first EOS inclusive; without EOS keep all emitted tokens, including PAD. No warmup; diagnostic timing.

paired_primary_fallback.interpretation: Exploratory, unadjusted exact two-sided McNemar; b=broken=base right/adapter wrong, c=fixed=base wrong/adapter right. No continuity correction; zero discordant pairs gives p=1.

limitations: Same first-letter fallback can misread longer reasoning; ambiguity/truncation reported. Equal observed accuracy is not retention equivalence or a general capability claim.
